title: 10u-14u Competitive Waitlist
introHtml: Our 10u-14u teams are currently waitlisted but are likely to have a few spaces open in the coming weeks, please fill out this form to be added to the waitlist.  We will contact you when space is available.

notes: Captured from Cognito load-form/form-def (embedded modelOptions + template). Session secrets, bot challenges, and encryption keys were stripped and are not stored here.
flags.ConditionalVisibility is true on the session, but no field has a ShowWhen / VisibleWhen rule. The only conditional logic is the homeschooled required-value: the answer must be Yes.
IsThisYourFirstExperienceWithOmahaLightningBasketball defaults to false (No) and is not required.
Father/Mother Name help text says fill N/A if the fields do not apply; Email and Phone on those rows are still required with format checks.
